help_first: Use the Merge Survey Projects command to merge (import) edited survey data from one or more VCE (.vce) projects into a single "master" VCE project.

caption: Reorder By Selection
help_first: The Reorder by Selection Order command enables you to reorder the point IDs by tracing a line over the points. It re-orders the point numbers so they increase in the same order in which they were selected.

help_first: If the geoid file you want to use for data collection is too large, define a subsection of the area (sub-grid) to use before uploading to a field device. This saves upload time and field device memory.
